entries.title: Draft obstruction: subcritical pointwise decay does not pass to criticality
entries.statement: DRAFT; independent check pending from w431. Pointwise decay for p<p_* together with finite-n continuity and monotonicity does not imply decay at p_*. For p_* in (0,1), 0<=p<=p_*, n>=1, f_n(p)=exp(-(p_*-p)n)/2 has those properties but f_n(p_*)=1/2.
assumptions: This is an abstract family of numbers, not claimed to arise from nearest-neighbour percolation.
entries.domain: probability: nearest-neighbour percolation and dependent-site renormalization

entries.title: Draft obstruction: no uniform positive exponential rate up to criticality
entries.statement: DRAFT; independent check pending from w431. For nearest-neighbour Bernoulli bond percolation on Z^d, every integer d>=2 and n>=1 satisfy P_(p_c)(0 connects to boundary Lambda_n)>=1/[2d p_c (2n+1)^(d-1)]. In particular no constants delta>0, C<infinity, c_0>0 bound these probabilities by C exp(-c_0 n) simultaneously for all n and p in (p_c-delta,p_c).
assumptions: Independent homogeneous Bernoulli bond percolation on nearest-neighbour Z^d
Lambda_n is the integer infinity-norm box
Duminil-Copin--Tassion Theorem 1.1 identifying the finite-set threshold with p_c

entries.title: Draft criterion: polynomial dependence-range threshold by whole-square coarsening
entries.statement: DRAFT; independent check pending from w431. Let d>=2, integer r>=0, and X in {0,1}^{Z^d} have independent sigma-fields on any two sets separated by infinity-norm distance greater than r. If P(X_x=0)<=64^(-4)/(r+1)^2 for every x, then P(0 belongs to an infinite nearest-neighbour good component)>0.
assumptions: Setwise sigma-field independence, not merely pairwise independence
Nearest-neighbour good components; no FKG or stationarity required

entries.title: Draft obstruction: comparison parameter stays below criticality at positive density
entries.statement: DRAFT; independent check pending from w431. For nearest-neighbour Bernoulli bond percolation on Z^d, d>=2, with independently green vertices of density 1-exp(-h), let m_h(p)=P_(p,h)(C(0) meets green). For every h>0, q_h=p_c(1-m_h(p_c))<=p_c(1-theta(p_c)), and lim_(h down to 0) q_h=p_c(1-theta(p_c)). Thus q_h tends to p_c if and only if theta(p_c)=0.
assumptions: Independent green vertex marks independent of the bond configuration

entries.title: Draft reference criterion: fixed-range coloring and contours
entries.statement: DRAFT; independent check pending from w431. Let d>=2 and integer r>=0. Let X be a {0,1}-valued field on Z^d whose sigma-fields on any two vertex sets at infinity-norm distance greater than r are independent. If P(X_x=0)<=64^(-(r+1)^2) for every x, the origin has positive probability of belonging to an infinite nearest-neighbour good component. This is w429 L2, the conservative parity-color and bad-star-contour criterion; it assumes setwise independence, not merely pairwise independence. Independent review is pending.

entries.title: Draft conditional bridge and unresolved critical block construction
entries.statement: DRAFT; independent check pending from w431. In nearest-neighbour Bernoulli bond percolation on Z^d, d>=2, let p_c in (0,1). Suppose there are fixed events G_z, z in a coarse Z^2, each determined by at most M>=1 bond bits. For coarse index sets at infinity-norm distance >integer r>=0, assume the unions of their determining edge sets are disjoint. Assume every infinite nearest-neighbour collection of good indices yields an infinite physical open cluster for every configuration. If P_(p_c)(G_z fails)<=delta<epsilon_r=64^-4/(r+1)^2 uniformly in z, then eta=min(p_c/2,(epsilon_r-delta)/(2M))>0 preserves bad marginals below epsilon_r at p'=p_c-eta, giving percolation below p_c by the candidate square-coarsening criterion, a contradiction. The unproved premise for C0023 is existence, from hypothetical theta(p_c)>0, of such fixed local compatible blocks with this quantitative margin. Qualitative density tending to one with uncontrolled r does not establish it.
assumptions: The square-coarsening criterion remains independently unchecked
Fixed local determining sets at both p_c and p'

relations.rationale: Whole-good squares of side r+1 form a setwise 1-dependent field on a coordinate plane, with bad marginal <=(r+1)^2 delta. The fixed-range criterion at r=1 requires bad marginal <=64^-4. Adjacent fully good squares connect through their faces.

A coupling changes any fixed M-bit event probability by at most M*eta. The stated strict margin keeps the same compatible block field under the candidate criterion at p_c-eta. This relation does not assert existence of the blocks.

The retrieved comparison theorem uses q=p(1-m_h(p)), h>0. The new deduction expands the omitted magnetization definition and shows q_h->p_c requires theta(p_c)=0; it cites and does not refute the comparison theorem.

These are distinct endpoint obstructions: a hypothetical positive critical density prevents the comparison parameter approaching p_c, while the finite-set threshold prevents any uniformly positive exponential rate across all p just below p_c.
